svg.title: Visual-stream runtime telemetry
svg.desc: Attention size, time to first token, and generation throughput across 491 cognitive ticks.
svg.text: Exploratory continuous-situation run: bounded state, unbounded latency
One model call at every 140 ms situation boundary; Qwen3.5 9B Q4 on Kaiju CPU, 1,000-word Attention cap.
Thin lines: per-tick measurements. Thick lines: centered 21-tick rolling mean. All 491 neural calls missed the 140 ms boundary.
